Text: The pickaxe is more of a tool than a weapon, yet in times of need it is better than nothing and one should not forget that its sharp point is used to crack rocks.
This hempen rope has been carefully coiled to ensure it doesn't get tangled with future use.
After you establish a stronghold along the Sword Coast, messengers will arrive bringing new quests. Accepting a quest might reveal a new area on the world map.

The new world map feature allows you to travel between the many areas in the world. You can quickly return to areas that you have already visited, or if you leave an area from a new direction, you may uncover a hidden adjoining area!
Once you have settled into your stronghold, you will have the opportunity to customize it to suit your tastes.
It pays to be prepared when traveling via the world map. There may be unsavory characters or creatures lying in wait for you...
Derval Ironeater, at Derval's Bright Blade in Daggerford, can forge powerful weapons for you if you bring him any artifact pieces that you have discovered.
Don't forget to rest at least once every 36 hours, or you will get tired and suffer a penalty during combat.
After gaining a new experience level, your henchmen will share more stories about themselves if you ask them.
If you decide to rest in the wilderness or in other dangerous areas, your rest may be disturbed by hostile creatures.
You can sometimes use ropes to access areas that might otherwise be inaccessible.
"The outlook is golden!" - Matagar Bugo, the Baron of Daggerford.
Beware of any trolls that you encounter! They can only be permanently killed using fire or acid.
